newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RBNZ says Dec qtr underlying inflation 0.63 pct.
newsitem.headline: RBNZ says Dec qtr underlying inflation 0.63 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand said on Friday that underlying inflation for the December 1996 quarter was 0.63 percent, making 2.40 percent for the year.

The central bank, which is mandated to aim for underlying inflation between 0-3 percent, had forecast a quarterly rate of 0.5 percent, for an annual rate of 2.3 percent. Economists' consensus forecast was for 0.41 percent quarterly and 2.15 percent annually.
